svg.title: S4 — Read-model synchronisation when a replica starts (new replica, wiped database, or late start)

g.text: S4 — Read-model synchronisation when a replica starts (new replica, wiped database, or late start)
listeners running (it receives events from now on)
[each airport in the write model of airports-1 (OPO, LIS)]
OPO, LIS → its read model (upsert, same version = same row)
MAD, CDG (queue airports-1.airports) → read model complete
Why: a queue only receives the events published AFTER it was declared.
Safe to repeat: projections are idempotent (eventId) and ignore older versions.
airport-sync.requested does not match airport.*, so other services (Flight Routes) never receive it.
